body.about: The physical side of the character: strength, precise movement and energy for long effort.
body.grows: Grows from anything done with the body: sport and training, work on your feet and with your hands, dance, walks, repairs, gardening, cooking, caring for children and family.

mind.about: How the character thinks: knowledge, attention and the ability to stay focused on hard things.
mind.grows: Grows from study and reading hard texts, working with information and code, problem solving, languages, driving and observation, and long focused sessions.

spirit.about: Connection with people and with yourself: leading, empathising and creating.
spirit.grows: Grows from teaching and public speaking, negotiation and sales, caring for people and animals, raising children, art, music, writing and any creative work.

strength.about: Muscle strength and the ability to handle heavy physical work.
strength.grows: Strength training, athletics, carrying loads, construction, warehouse and field work.

dexterity.about: Precision and coordination: body and hands do what you intend.
dexterity.grows: Technical sports, dance, figure skating, musical instruments, handicraft, manual repair, cooking, lab work.

endurance.about: Stamina for long effort. Raises max HP.
endurance.grows: Cardio and walks, shifts on your feet, long physical work, patient care, housekeeping.

intellect.about: Knowledge and the ability to make sense of complex things.
intellect.grows: Study, science, programming, languages, reading hard texts, analysis, medicine, finance.

perception.about: Attention to detail and to what happens around you.
perception.grows: Driving, diagnostics and observation, quality control, drawing from life, lab experiments, security work.

will.about: Discipline and focus: doing hard things for long and regularly.
will.grows: Long focused sessions, hard tasks, consistency, project management, job search, self-learning.

charisma.about: Talking to people, persuading and leading.
charisma.grows: Teaching, public speaking, negotiation, sales, leading people, customer work.

empathy.about: Understanding others and caring for them.
empathy.grows: Psychology, nursing, raising children, supporting family, volunteering, caring for animals.

creativity.grows: Drawing, music, writing, design, photography, handicraft, invention, creative cooking.

attrSheet.progressLine: {stars}/10 stars · {xp} more XP and {days} more active days
attrSheet.rules: Attributes grow slowly and only from real activity: skill experience is split between the skill primary (2/3) and secondary (1/3) attribute. 10 stars give +1 point, but a point also needs several different active days: one marathon is not enough.
attrSheet.unfoldText: When the conditions are met, the System offers to unfold the attribute into three. Their values depend on what you actually invested in. Unfolding is optional: you can keep the general attribute forever.
attrSheet.bonus: Gives: +2% experience to skills where it is primary, per point above 10 (up to +30%).
attrSheet.hpBonus: Gives: +10 max HP per point above 10.
